capabilities: Run shell commands in Termux from a command modal
Insert command output into the current note at the cursor
Use an interactive live terminal view inside Obsidian
Install and remove the Python bridge server via automated scripts
Authenticate connections with a generated security token
extras: Setup requires running an automated script in Termux that installs Python and OpenSSL, downloads a Python server script, generates a token, and configures ~/.bashrc to auto-start the server; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian on Android cannot reliably run shell commands because of Android Intent restrictions, so users cannot execute Termux commands from inside their vault.
summary: Termux integration bridge that runs shell commands on Android from Obsidian via a local HTTP server with token authentication.
